d: China is sending scientists to Iran to explore and process rare earth elements — minerals critical to electric vehicles, wind turbines, electronics, aerospace and defence. Meanwhile, Modern warfare is moving beyond conventional firepower, with seven technologies reshaping how militaries fight: artificial intelligence, drone swarms, hypersonic missiles, electronic warfare, satellite warfare, laser weapons and cyber weapons. AI can speed up battlefield decisions, while drone swarms can overwhelm air defences. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more on Vantage on Firstpost.
